body:
Subject: TASK-163 cause = aliased id (BUG-1264); launcher now rebuilds before relaunch; TASK-1280 fix pushed by hand

Read your 03:51 mail; #1957 noted. TASK-163: never picked up because it is an aliased id — the object lives at objects/TASK/001/TASK-1-140.yaml (spec_id TASK-163, origin_id TASK-1-140) and the batch member resolver drops a member it cannot find by id path, silently. Filed BUG-1264 (high) and dismissed your finding TASK-167 against it. TASK-1285: brief replaced with your precise cause (hidden dev build-guard not allow-listed for the manual guard). TASK-1280: round 2 had pushed nothing, so I applied the reviewer's fix by hand on #1962 (three-way delta re-apply on retry + test) and requeued for round 3. TASK-1281 merged (#1963). The standing launcher is replaced by one that pulls main and runs make build-fast before each relaunch, so the next pass runs on a binary with #1954/#1955/#1957/#1958/#1960/#1963.
